summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to complete phases 42 (API unpin integrity), 43 (FUSE write durability), and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) — the three remaining gap-closure phases for milestone v1.1 — including inline discussion of all three phases, followed by automated plan and wave-based parallel execution of each.
summary.outcome: All three phases were successfully discussed, planned, executed through worktree-isolated wave execution, code-reviewed, verified, and marked complete. Milestone v1.1 is now fully done.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) was publicly accessible to any account holder (JwtAuthGuard only, open signup) with no ownership check — any JWT could destroy another user's pinned content.

CIDs are public identifiers: Kubo runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly, so DHT provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast network-wide. IPNS records also resolve publicly.

Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (shared-write.ts:450) without calling unpin — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists, making the missing ownership check a pure cross-tenant data-destruction surface.
BYO IPFS unpin was broken in both directions; new server-side guardedUnpin semantics fix it for free since 'not pinned' is swallowed as a benign error.

The 403 response for cross-user unpin creates an oracle risk if not uniform, conflates benign races with malicious probes in monitoring, and misleads REST clients expecting idempotent delete semantics — silent 2XX + audit log is the correct choice.

pnpm filter + jest: 'pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X' breaks because pnpm inserts a bare '--', making jest treat the flag as a positional regex. Use 'pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern=X' instead.
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true in git Bash calls; never use --no-gpg-sign as PRs enforce signatures.
The gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative — always verify with git log rather than retrying blindly.
Cross-package builds: after modifying sdk-core or sdk source, downstream web typechecks fail against stale dist unless 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build' (or sdk) is run explicitly before tsc.
cleanup-wave helper resolves repoRoot from cwd — must always be run from the repo root, never from inside a worktree, to avoid false base_mismatch errors.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged worktree entries report branch_mismatch on re-run. Write a reduced manifest with only remaining unmerged entries before retrying.

Windows WinFsp cross-compilation ('cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp') fails on macOS due to pre-existing issues in windows-future and winfsp-sys crates — use 'cargo check' to verify project code is error-free instead.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). The server profile only disables local-network discovery — full public DHT participation is retained, broadcasting provider records for every pinned CID.
Upload-compensation path called a global 'pin/rm' on a CID that content-addressed dedup could share with another user — now rerouted through guardedUnpin with D-13 race window comment.

guardedUnpin implemented with pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) to close concurrent-delete refcount races; transactional row-delete + refcount + outbox insert; Kubo pin/rm called post-commit as best-effort; cross-user attempts emit audit metric and return silent 2XX.

After phase 44 gap plans, this file reads result.publishedChildren but the @cipherbox/sdk dist was stale — caused 8 false tsc errors until sdk was rebuilt. Type errors here should trigger a dist rebuild check before debugging code.

CR-08 journal.remove call was present in the background upload thread — the Linux FUSE path intentionally removed this (replay-on-mount is the authoritative cleanup), but the Windows path missed the alignment. Fixed post-verification.

mergeChildren is a pure three-way merge (10 permutations, D-01/D-02): base + local + remote children, 18 unit tests. Called with baseChildren snapshot captured before any local write, not the post-write state.

CR-02: prunedCids must be filtered against mergedMetadata.versions references in the file 409 conflict path — without this filter, versions still referenced in the merged metadata would be unpinned, causing data loss.

Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin — this is the intentional behavior (no cross-user unpin), but it creates a quota leak for shared-write prunedCids that is tracked as a deferred issue.

workflow: When the gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false', always verify with 'git log --oneline -1' before retrying — false negatives are common and blind retries create duplicate commits.
Worktrees accumulate node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs that block cleanup-wave merge. Adding an explicit 'rm -rf node_modules .husky/_' step to executor prompts prevents this.
A merge that leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed) is concluded with 'git commit --no-edit' rather than resetting and re-merging.

nest build has a side-effect of reformatting openapi.json in the main tree — always 'git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json' before merging agent worktrees to avoid 500+ line formatting-only conflicts.
Decision coverage gates use literal string matching (e.g., 'D-07:') — plan must_haves sections must cite the exact decision ID token for the gate to pass.
Post-wave merges should run targeted test patterns, never full monorepo suites, to stay within RAM constraints in the orchestrator context.
For gap closure plans, spawn the verifier only after all gap plans are merged and gated — not after the initial execution, even if the initial verification found gaps.

Phase 43 required a UAT file (43-UAT.md) for 4 runtime items that cannot be verified in CI: journal durability on crash, tray notification on WriteParked, replay on mount, and conflict drain retry. Verifier correctly classified these as human_needed rather than blocking.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures ('agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object') occurred multiple times, requiring user to restart the 1Password app before git commits would succeed.
Session quota limits hit 3 times mid-execution, interrupting background executor wave tracking and requiring manual recovery instructions from the user.
Accidental user input ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted the execute-phase 43 wave 3 dispatch twice, requiring explicit 'please continue' to resume.

The assistant initially presented the same AskUserQuestion menu instead of answering the user's direct questions about the unpin threat model — required explicit correction from the user: 'you did not answer my question, just presented the same answers for me to choose from'.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent and had a cwd-sensitivity bug: running it from inside an agent worktree directory caused all merge attempts to report false base_mismatch errors.
The planner had a socket disconnection mid-run after writing plans 01-03, requiring manual detection of which plans were complete and spawning a continuation planner for 04-08.
openapi.json formatting drift (564+ lines, formatting-only) from a nest build side-effect in the main tree blocked the 42-05 worktree merge until manually restored.
zsh multi-glob rm (-rf 'node_modules apps/*/node_modules') aborts entirely if any glob pattern matches nothing — required splitting into single-path rm calls.

Web tsc reported 8 errors after the phase 44 gap-wave merge that were entirely due to stale @cipherbox/sdk dist, not real code issues — required recognizing the cross-package dist pattern before diagnosing.
The .prettierignore file was missing entirely, causing prettier to mangle planning docs and break a VALIDATION.md table's regex pipe into a table column separator.
open_items: SECURITY.md is missing for Phase 42 — run /gsd-secure-phase 42 to generate and commit it; security enforcement is enabled and this was flagged during close-out routing.

Phase 43 UAT: 4 runtime items require manual verification on a real mount: (1) journal survives crash and replays on remount, (2) tray WriteParked notification fires, (3) conflict drain re-arms on MkdirConflict, (4) Windows WinFsp replay_for_vault runs on mount.
Pending-uploads UI: a full UI showing queued/parked writes was deferred from Phase 43 discuss as a future improvement — noted in CONTEXT.md but not tracked as a todo.

BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring: the server-side guardedUnpin now handles BYO advisory rows correctly, but wiring provider.unpin into BYO delete flows (client side) was explicitly deferred from Phase 42.

Writable-share prunedCids leak: shared-write saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin — versions pruned during a shared write are not cleaned from IPFS, creating a quota/storage leak. Deferred from Phase 42.
Rust FUSE merge parity: three-way merge logic (mergeChildren equivalent) was not implemented in the Rust FUSE crate — deferred from Phase 44 as D-09 explicitly excludes Rust.
REQUIREMENTS traceability gap flagged by the verifier for Phase 44 is pre-existing, not introduced by this milestone — needs investigation in a separate session.

Phase 43 Windows WinFsp cross-compilation on macOS fails in pre-existing crates (windows-future, winfsp-sys registry crates) — the project code compiles clean via cargo check but 'cargo build --features winfsp' cannot pass on macOS CI.
